standard_prerequisites.name: Gluing a single simplex
standard_prerequisites.use: Each step of the chain U = W^0 subset W^1 subset ... subset W^r = V must satisfy the hypotheses of Lemma lemma-glue-simplex, so that each inclusion is a pushout of a boundary inclusion.

core_obligations: Statement (lines 3345-3356): if U subset V are simplicial sets with finite nonempty components and finitely many nondegenerate simplices, there is a chain U = W^0 subset ... subset W^r = V to which Lemma lemma-glue-simplex applies at each step.

Verification (proof lines 3358-3372): take the least n with a nondegenerate x in V_n outside U_n; let W be U plus all repeated degeneracies of x; the inclusion U subset W satisfies the hypotheses of Lemma lemma-glue-simplex, and W misses exactly one fewer nondegenerate simplex of V than U does; induction on this count terminates at V.
proof_roadmap: Pick the lowest-degree nondegenerate simplex of V missing from U.
Adjoin it together with all its degeneracies; check the gluing hypotheses.
Iterate; the count of missing nondegenerate simplices strictly decreases.
difficulty_reason: Induction skeleton (statement 3345-3356, proof 3358-3372): the reduction is explicit - minimal degree choice, the degeneracy closure W with the gluing hypotheses verified, and the strictly decreasing count; rides on registered Lemma lemma-glue-simplex. H3.
